summary: A 1959 Forest Service tower on O'Leary Peak north of Flagstaff, occupied from 1959 by a Flagstaff gunsmith and registered in 2006; the approach road has an active access alert.

facts.design: 14 x 14 ft CL-100 series live-in cab with catwalk on a metal tower (register); a 1959 build log says 30 ft

access.note: Forest Service alert says O'Leary access is restricted and NPS Road 545 is closed between SR 89 and Sunset Crater. The blocked forest road leaves about a mile of hiking to the base of the peak.

visit.trail_note: Walk from the blocked forest road about a mile to the base of the peak, then six switchbacks to the tower, which sits on a neighboring summit.

events.note: Forest Service memo says the agency had wanted a lookout on O'Leary Peak for about thirty years
Contract to Martin Cline of Globe, Arizona, winning bid $5,480; tower erected June 1959; register gives construction year 1959
Marion J. Bedwell, a Flagstaff gunsmith, moved into the tower July 11, 1959, and was living there with his husky Buck, per a late-July 1959 newspaper profile
Registered March 15, 2006 as US 679, AZ 66; nominated by Dave Lorenz

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register 8,916 ft for the lookout, Forest Service trail page 8,911 ft for the tower, Wikipedia infobox 8,919 ft for the peak's highest point (the tower is not on the peak). The story reports the three figures and does not pick one.

Register: 32 ft metal tower with 14 x 14 ft live-in cab. The 1959 build log says a 30-foot tower; the 1959 newspaper describes a 20-foot-square glass-enclosed tower. The story reports the register figures and notes the older accounts.

notes_for_editor: Current staffing and climbing status are not established by any source read; the story says so. The 1959 history comes from a compiled newspaper log on westlookouts.weebly.com; the original clippings were not checked. The brief's access 'unknown' is changed to restricted based on an undated Forest Service alert. The 1952 memo and 1959 newspaper quotes are secondhand via that compilation.
